articles.summary: International Seaways, Inc. (NYSE: INSW) (the “Company,” “Seaways,” or “INSW”), one of the largest tanker companies worldwide providing energy transportation services for crude oil and petroleum products, today reported results for the third quarter 2026. HIGHLIGHTS RECENT DEVELOPMENTS Strategic Fleet Expansion: Acquired Bruton Limited (“Bruton”) and its four newbuilding VLCCs primarily for total consideration of approximately three million shares and cash. Took delivery of two LR1 newbuilds with the remaining four on order expected to deliver in the second half of 2028. Sold a 2012-built Suezmax for proceeds, net of commissions and fees, of $74 million, recognizing a gain of $53 million. Quarterly Results: Record net income of $344 million, or $6.90 per diluted share, including $53 million gain on sale. Near-record adjusted net income (1) of $291 million, or $5.84 per diluted share, and adjusted EBITDA (1) of $345 million. Strong quarterly free cash flow (1) of $234 million.
articles.title: International Seaways Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
